# Accepted pre-extraction Frontend rollback fixture

This file-only distribution contains the 256 Full files from the accepted Product `2b0f1252777efcc6d60446ec489fa4b83231ece2` main CI (run `44176592034`, immutable artifact `14370647671`). Its original GitHub ZIP SHA256 is recorded in `pin.json`; every decompressed file matches the accepted Linux and Windows proof. The portable gzip file map uses `solovey.frontend-file-archive/v1`.

This is generated rollback data. The previous source remains in Product Git history. Product normally resolves the external Frontend producer pin; composition qualification explicitly reverses its artifact selection to this admitted historical snapshot, verifies every file, embeds it, then reapplies the external pin. No user data, schema, signed release sequence or runtime download is involved.
